scope: The accuracy tier. For every pinned platform corpus on disk, whole recordings are held out, the generic recipe is fitted on the rest, the structured model is fitted on exactly the same training recordings, and both forecast the same held-out origins from the same recorded future commands. This tier measures forecast accuracy against the structured model and the task allowance. It is not control adequacy, calibrated uncertainty, or evidence about any corpus not listed here.
frozen: This file and its digest constant in glassbox.experimental.harness are frozen before a candidate is fitted. A threshold, stride, holdout, corpus, or reference value changed after scores were seen fails review. The corpus root is a command-line argument and never a fact in this file. The recipe block below records the recipe this manifest was frozen against: a candidate recipe may differ from it, and every run records the recipe it actually fitted. What the manifest pins about the recipe is the evaluation plan, the information budget every window is cut to, which each corpus declares and the harness rederives.

observed_contract.source: One adapter, no per-corpus branch: world-frame velocity and body rates are read from the canonical rigid-body state, and the nine rotation entries come from its quaternion through glassbox.core.geometry.quaternion_to_rotation_matrices, row-major. Inputs are the recorded controls, named from the trajectory's own spec. Position is not modeled. Recording identity is the file stem. A gap or a nonfinite row splits the recording into segments through sequence_collection's mask helper; nothing is padded.

scoring.origins: Every origin at the corpus's declared stride that carries the recipe's whole consumed context inside one segment and the whole forecast horizon after it. Both models forecast from the same origins with the same recorded future commands: the generic model through predict, the structured model through the library's rollout from that origin's full canonical state.
scoring.metric: One scalar over the scored rows and the three components, as glassbox.core.metrics computes velocity_rmse_m_s. Reported at the final horizon row and over the whole horizon prefix, pooled per corpus and per recording, for the generic model, every structured arm, and a hold-current baseline.
scoring.horizon: The recipe's 0.25 s horizon resolved on each corpus's own sample grid, so the realized horizon is 0.24 s where 0.25 s is not a whole number of steps and 0.2 s on the 5 Hz corpus.

decision.rule: For every declared corpus: the generic model's final-step velocity RMSE and body-rate RMSE on the held-out rows are at or below the structured comparator's on the same rows, and at or below the task allowance where one is declared.
decision.comparator: Per metric, the lowest value any declared structured arm reached on those rows. Both arms are reported in full.
decision.allowance: The allowances come from docs/accuracy-requirements.md, where they were derived as the worst recording's 95th percentile of the largest vector error anywhere in the forecast prefix. This rule applies them to a pooled final-step RMSE, which is a different readout of the same evidence and not the percentile those numbers bound.
decision.gates_merges_from: this manifest. A run is accepted only when no metric regresses past its reference value times 1.05 plus 0.005, the rule holds on every case the reference already meets it on, and nothing structural fails. A case the reference already fails is reported, not gated: an enforced rule the incumbent does not meet would block every change rather than measure one.
decision.rule_met: Reported separately from the decision, on every run. The accuracy row of docs/status.md is met only when the rule holds on every case, which is a stronger statement than an accepted run.
decision.meaning: Measured forecast accuracy on the pinned corpora for this manifest only. Not control adequacy, calibrated uncertainty, or readiness.

reference.meaning: When the reference file exists beside this manifest, no corpus's generic final-step velocity RMSE or body-rate RMSE may exceed its reference value times 1.05 plus 0.005. A run copies the reference it compared into its output directory and records its sha256, and verify anchors that copy to the committed file rather than believing it.
reference.gates_the_rule: The same recorded value decides which cases the rule gates. A corpus and metric whose reference value is itself at or below this run's comparator and the declared allowance is a case the reference meets, and the rule is a gate there; a case the reference already fails is reported only. With no reference compared there is no case the reference meets, and the rule is reported everywhere.

corpora.summary: IDSIA nano-quadrotor system identification, aggressive real flight.

structured.holdout_meaning: The fit is given exactly the training recordings and reserves the final source group of them for its own forecast-error calibration. The chain's own holdout rule selected the corpus's held-out recordings, which this manifest declares instead and never passes to the fit, so the structured model never sees a held-out row in any role.

recording_content.meaning: Every canonical recording is pinned by its corpus-relative filename, trajectory_sha256_v1 content digest, and complete labels. The digest covers all canonical arrays, timing, signal contract, and prior commands; labels additionally pin structured holdout and weighting. Storage roots, provenance, and NPZ compression are excluded. Every corpus is loaded and checked before either model is fitted, and both fits consume those verified in-memory trajectories. Each run copies this inventory; replay verifies its frozen digest and the recorded splits without reading the original corpus.
